role: Exploratory reporting extension requested after inspection of the manuscript; not preregistered

coverage.support: Intersection of a participant's eight actual first-level fitting masks; held fixed across conditions, stages and models
coverage.observed80: Average only observed ROI voxels; participant contributes only when at least 80% of the original ROI is observed
coverage.observed95: Same observed-voxel average with 95% coverage requirement
coverage.missing: Never treat unobserved voxels as measured zeros; preserve 48 planned slots using p=1 for untestable slots during BH adjustment

intervals: Two-sided pointwise 95% Student-t intervals, unadjusted for multiplicity or model selection

stage_comparisons.test: Within-participant differences using the same fixed observed support; initial baseline cancels
stage_comparisons.family: BH over 3 pairs x 48 ROI slots = 144; supplementary within-pair BH also retained

models: Nine completed canonical-HRF model specifications: 4 censor/filter cells plus derivative, SPM, motion12+tissue, motion12+aCompCor, precision weighting. Precision weighting changes the within-phase estimand.
model_multiplicity: Within-model/contrast BH across 48; within-model joint BH across 192; exploratory pooled BH across 9 x 4 x 48 = 1728. Pooled correction covers these enumerated tests only, not undocumented model/ROI searches or choosing the coverage policy.
units: Saved percent-signal-scaled canonical coefficients; stage contrast maps sum two run coefficients. Displayed condition curves use two-run means. No raw beta comparison with FIR/impulse models.
figure_roi_choice_reason: Fixed examples spanning premotor, frontal, parietal, thalamic, hippocampal and ventral-striatal parcels, chosen before the new group analyses; complete profiles for all 48 are exported
behavior: Exact imaging subject list; eight logged runs per participant; original Exp3 cycle assignment precedes cleaning; trimr::modifiedRecursive reconstruction with correct finite 0<RT<1-second responses, participant/block trimming. The unavailable custom helper is not claimed to be reproduced. Additional 100-ms lower-bound descriptive sensitivity. Equal participant weights; SEM for cycle figure; pointwise 95% CI for run summaries. No group-mean curve-based mechanistic model selection.
